title: Classical
subtitle: 本課限定語境：describing classical music · 描述古典音樂
description: 本課限定語境：describing classical music · 描述古典音樂

words.meaning: 藝術音樂的；藝術音樂傳統的
words.note: 在音樂學語境中，art music 常用來指與流行音樂、民間音樂等相對的正式藝術音樂傳統。
words.example: The course introduces students to the European art-music tradition.
words.exampleZh: 這門課向學生介紹歐洲藝術音樂傳統。

exercises.original: The course examines the classical tradition of nineteenth-century Europe.
exercises.zh: 這門課研究十九世紀歐洲的古典音樂傳統。
exercises.upgrade: The course examines the nineteenth-century European art-music tradition.

options.explanation: 在音樂學語境中，和 classical tradition 高度接近。
指民間／傳統音樂，不等於 classical。
通常與 classical/art music 對比。
描述商業性，不是音樂傳統。
以舞蹈功能分類，範圍不同。

exercises.original: She researches classical music and opera.
exercises.zh: 她研究古典音樂及歌劇。
exercises.upgrade: She researches art music and opera.

options.explanation: 正式學術語境中可概括 classical repertoire。

exercises.original: The library has a large collection devoted to classical composition.
exercises.zh: 圖書館收藏大量有關古典音樂創作的資料。
exercises.upgrade: The library has a large collection devoted to art-music composition.

words.meaning: 西方藝術音樂的；西方古典音樂傳統的
words.note: 如果原句的 classical 明確指西方古典音樂傳統，這是非常精確的正式改寫。
words.example: She specializes in nineteenth-century Western art music.
words.exampleZh: 她專門研究十九世紀西方藝術音樂。

exercises.original: The module introduces the history of classical music in Europe.
exercises.zh: 這個單元介紹歐洲古典音樂史。
exercises.upgrade: The module introduces the history of Western art music.

options.explanation: 最精確地把 classical 限定為西方古典藝術音樂傳統。

exercises.original: Her research focuses on classical composers from 1750 to 1900.
exercises.zh: 她的研究集中於 1750 至 1900 年間的古典作曲家。
exercises.upgrade: Her research focuses on Western art-music composers from 1750 to 1900.

options.explanation: 時間與 composer 研究脈絡明確指西方古典傳統。

exercises.original: The textbook surveys classical music from the Baroque to the twentieth century.
exercises.zh: 教科書概述從巴洛克到二十世紀的古典音樂。
exercises.upgrade: The textbook surveys Western art music from the Baroque to the twentieth century.

options.explanation: Baroque 等時期名稱是強烈線索。
演奏方式，不是歷史傳統。

words.meaning: 音樂廳藝術音樂的；正式演奏音樂的
words.note: 指主要為正式演出、音樂會環境而創作或演奏的音樂。
words.example: The station broadcasts both popular and concert music.
words.exampleZh: 該電台同時播放流行音樂和音樂會藝術音樂。

exercises.original: The radio station broadcasts both popular and classical music.
exercises.zh: 該電台同時播放流行音樂和古典音樂。
exercises.upgrade: The radio station broadcasts both popular and concert music.

options.explanation: 在「popular vs formal concert repertoire」對比中自然。

exercises.original: He composes classical music for formal performance.
exercises.zh: 他創作供正式演出的古典音樂。
exercises.upgrade: He composes concert music for formal performance.

options.explanation: for formal performance 是直接線索。

exercises.original: The venue is known for performances of new classical works.
exercises.zh: 該場地以演奏新的古典藝術作品聞名。
exercises.upgrade: The venue is known for performances of new concert-music works.

options.explanation: 新創作的正式藝術音樂未必是傳統「古典曲目」，但 concert music 很合適。

words.meaning: 嚴肅音樂的；藝術音樂的
words.note: 較舊式的說法，用來把 classical / art music 和 popular entertainment music 區分。
words.example: The critic wrote extensively about serious music and opera.
words.exampleZh: 這位樂評人廣泛撰寫嚴肅音樂及歌劇評論。

exercises.original: Older critics often contrasted classical music with popular entertainment.
exercises.zh: 較早期的樂評人常把古典音樂和流行娛樂作對比。
exercises.upgrade: Older critics often contrasted serious music with popular entertainment.

options.explanation: 這是較舊式的分類用語，語境吻合。

exercises.original: The essay uses an old-fashioned term for classical composition.
exercises.zh: 文章使用一個較老派的詞來稱呼古典音樂創作。
exercises.upgrade: The essay refers to classical composition as serious music.

options.explanation: 老式文化評論中可能這樣稱呼。

exercises.original: The archive contains essays on classical music written in the 1950s.
exercises.zh: 檔案館收藏二十世紀五十年代有關古典音樂的文章。
exercises.upgrade: The archive contains essays on serious music written in the 1950s.

options.explanation: 歷史語境可成立，但現代使用需留意其價值判斷色彩。

words.note: 當 classical 實際指「由管弦樂團演奏的古典音樂」時可自然改寫。
words.example: The festival features orchestral works by several major composers.
words.exampleZh: 音樂節演奏多位重要作曲家的管弦樂作品。

exercises.original: The festival presents classical works performed by a full symphony orchestra.
exercises.zh: 音樂節演奏由完整交響樂團演出的古典作品。
exercises.upgrade: The festival presents orchestral works performed by a full symphony orchestra.

options.explanation: 有 full symphony orchestra，因此可精確改寫。

exercises.original: The programme consists mainly of classical pieces for orchestra.
exercises.zh: 節目主要由管弦樂古典作品組成。
exercises.upgrade: The programme consists mainly of orchestral pieces.

options.explanation: 歌劇音樂不一定是此處所指。

exercises.original: She prefers classical music written for large ensembles.
exercises.zh: 她偏好為大型樂團創作的古典音樂。
exercises.upgrade: She prefers orchestral music written for large ensembles.

options.explanation: large ensembles 明確指管弦樂團類型。

words.note: 當 classical music 的語境特別涉及交響曲或大型管弦樂作品時很自然。
words.example: The programme is devoted to symphonic music of the late Romantic period.
words.exampleZh: 節目專門演奏浪漫主義晚期的交響音樂。

exercises.original: The concert focuses on large-scale classical works for symphony orchestra.
exercises.zh: 音樂會集中演奏大型交響古典作品。
exercises.upgrade: The concert focuses on large-scale symphonic works.

options.explanation: 大型交響樂團作品最適合。

exercises.original: He is best known for his classical orchestral writing, especially symphonies.
exercises.zh: 他最以古典管弦樂創作聞名，尤其是交響曲。
exercises.upgrade: He is best known for his symphonic writing.

exercises.original: The conductor specializes in classical repertoire for symphony orchestra.
exercises.zh: 這位指揮專門演繹交響樂團古典曲目。
exercises.upgrade: The conductor specializes in symphonic repertoire.

options.explanation: 指交響樂團核心曲目最精確。

words.meaning: 器樂音樂會作品；正式器樂藝術音樂
words.note: 當 classical 強調非流行、正式演出的器樂作品時，可作較精確改寫。
words.example: The series focuses on instrumental concert music from the eighteenth century.
words.exampleZh: 這個系列專注十八世紀的器樂音樂會作品。

exercises.original: The series presents classical instrumental works from the eighteenth century.
exercises.zh: 系列演奏十八世紀古典器樂作品。
exercises.upgrade: The series presents eighteenth-century instrumental concert music.

options.explanation: 正式演出＋器樂作品，描述精確。

exercises.original: The archive focuses on classical works written for instruments rather than voice.
exercises.zh: 檔案館專注非聲樂的古典器樂作品。
exercises.upgrade: The archive focuses on instrumental concert music rather than vocal music.

exercises.original: Her research examines classical instrumental repertoire performed in public concerts.
exercises.zh: 她研究在公開音樂會演奏的古典器樂曲目。
exercises.upgrade: Her research examines instrumental concert music performed in public concerts.

options.explanation: 三個元素：instrumental + formal + concert，完全吻合。

words.note: 在複合形容詞位置，直接使用 classical-music 可比硬找同義形容詞更自然。
words.example: She writes classical-music reviews for a national newspaper.
words.exampleZh: 她為全國性報章撰寫古典音樂評論。

exercises.original: She writes classical reviews for a national newspaper.
exercises.zh: 她為全國性報章撰寫古典音樂評論。
exercises.upgrade: She writes classical-music reviews for a national newspaper.

options.explanation: 若 classical 單獨作前置形容詞可能稍含糊，明寫 classical-music 更清楚。
classic 表示經典，不等於古典音樂。

exercises.original: The magazine has a section devoted to classical recordings.
exercises.zh: 雜誌有一個專門介紹古典音樂錄音的欄目。
exercises.upgrade: The magazine has a section devoted to classical-music recordings.

options.explanation: 清楚指出 recordings 的音樂類型。

exercises.original: He works as a classical critic.
exercises.zh: 他是一名古典音樂評論家。
exercises.upgrade: He works as a classical-music critic.

options.explanation: 避免 classical critic 被理解為「古典主義評論家」等其他含義。

words.meaning: 傳統音樂會曲目的；傳統古典曲目的
words.note: 當 classical 指常見於正式音樂會的傳統曲目時，這個表達很有用。
words.example: The orchestra performs both new works and traditional concert repertoire.
words.exampleZh: 樂團既演奏新作品，也演奏傳統音樂會曲目。

exercises.original: The orchestra balances new music with classical favourites.
exercises.zh: 樂團在新音樂與傳統古典曲目之間取得平衡。
exercises.upgrade: The orchestra balances new music with traditional concert repertoire.

options.explanation: 這裡 classical favourites 指長期常演的古典曲目。

exercises.original: Many audiences still enjoy the standard classical repertoire.
exercises.zh: 很多觀眾仍然喜歡標準傳統古典曲目。
exercises.upgrade: Many audiences still enjoy traditional concert repertoire.

options.explanation: standard repertoire 明確指長期建立的音樂會曲目。

exercises.original: The season includes contemporary works alongside familiar classical pieces.
exercises.zh: 本樂季除當代作品外，也包括熟悉的傳統古典曲目。
exercises.upgrade: The season includes contemporary works alongside traditional concert repertoire.

options.explanation: 與 contemporary works 對比時尤其自然。

words.meaning: 經典音樂會曲目的；正典曲目的
words.note: 當 classical 實際帶有「公認經典曲目」的意思時自然。
words.example: The season combines contemporary pieces with canonical concert repertoire.
words.exampleZh: 本樂季把當代作品與經典音樂會曲目結合。

exercises.original: The course covers the best-known classical works of the standard repertoire.
exercises.zh: 課程涵蓋標準曲目中最著名的古典作品。
exercises.upgrade: The course covers canonical concert repertoire.

options.explanation: 強調被視為核心、經典的曲目。

exercises.original: The orchestra performs classical masterpieces alongside new commissions.
exercises.zh: 樂團在新委約作品之外，也演奏古典經典名作。
exercises.upgrade: The orchestra performs canonical concert repertoire alongside new commissions.

options.explanation: masterpieces + new commissions 的對比很吻合。
是流行經典，不是 classical canon。

exercises.original: Students are expected to know the central classical repertoire.
exercises.zh: 學生應熟悉核心古典曲目。
exercises.upgrade: Students are expected to know the canonical concert repertoire.

options.explanation: central 表示核心正典曲目。

falseSynonyms.zh: 傳統的 ≠ 古典音樂的 traditional music 通常可指民間、民族或代代相傳的音樂。 兩者不可直接互換。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She studies classical music. She studies traditional Irish music.

falseSynonyms.zh: 管弦樂的 ≠ 所有古典音樂 Beethoven symphonies 可以是 orchestral； Bach keyboard music 或 Chopin piano music 則不是 orchestral。
交響性的 ≠ 所有 classical symphonic 是 classical repertoire 的一個子類。
原聲的 ≠ 古典的 沒有電子擴音不代表是 classical。 民謠和爵士也可以是 acoustic。
器樂的 ≠ 古典的 instrumental music 可以是 jazz、rock、film music 等。
歌劇的 ≠ 所有古典音樂 opera 是 classical tradition 的一部分，但不是全部。
室內樂的 ≠ 所有古典音樂 chamber music 是古典音樂的重要子類，但範圍比 classical 小。
classic 和 classical 不可隨意互換 - classical music = 古典音樂 - a classic song = 一首經典歌曲 classic music 通常不是「古典音樂」的標準說法。
